column1: # The staff rolls: the ending roll (load LBA 0x82, bank $85: 45 headings then 68 names) and the opening roll's
# headings (sector 170). One line per credit: the Japanese exactly as the disc has it (without the padding
# full-width spaces), a tab, the English. English is written as letter-pair cells centred in the same 14-cell
# line, so 28 letters is the limit. Names are romanised surname last, as Konami did for the Sega CD; readings
# marked (?) are best guesses for staff without a known Western credit.
